text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The ocean!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No sooner do we arrive at summer camp
than Fine Motion takes off to
marvel at
the sea.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: No, far from it. Though it is the first time I've been to one with so many friends. It's like a dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the sensation of sand between my toes, and just... everything. It feels like such a treasure to be here!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It really is! Oh—is that a hermit crab? I
wonder if it's looking for a new
shell.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, little guy.
Can I help you look? I bet
this beach is full of
beautiful shells!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
All right, are we all ready to run some
laps? ...Hang on, where'd Fine
go?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there she is! Looks like she's already
started jogging! C'mon, let's
hurry and
catch up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion runs down the shoreline,
beaming. Time flies, and camp
goes by in a
happy blur.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, it's the evening of our
last night. Fine and I decide
to spend it at
the local festival.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that was lovely! What was "candy
floss" in Japanese, again? "Wata-ame,"
right?
The way it melts in your mouth is so
delightful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. All this training, and playing,
and cooking, and treasure
hunts. Ghost stories
and now a big festival... This camp really
had it all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah! Fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They're so... so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...And then in a blink, they're
memories—like all the other precious

moments we shared.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I think, maybe it's their fleeting nature
that makes them linger so
vividly in the
mind when they're gone. Do you know
what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no,
I'm sorry. I hope I didn't spoil the
festival mood with the
sentimental talk.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What do you say we give the stalls another
round? I spotted a sign for
jumbo takoyaki
down that way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We wander for a while, chatting and
snacking, and end summer camp
on a high
note.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That's the whole training set for
today, I believe. It feels like
it's been
forever since I ran on the academy track.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. Although, you never know when
life will surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm afraid not this time. Though it
would be fun to have little surprises like
the lost kitty. You know,
just from time to
time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, I don't know what I expected. Not that I want there to be lost pets, mind you. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Eh? Is this... instant ramen? Was this
always here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I almost forgot. When I cleaned up after
our feline visitor, I moved my emergency
snack stash.
I can't believe I left ramen out
where Fine could see it...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Shura Ramen III? I don't think I've
ever seen this kind!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you, Trainer! Let me boil
some water...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What do you mean? I thought you
only needed water.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You... can? You can add other things?! But
that means... the
possibilities are infinite!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness! My mind is racing with
ideas already! I have to try
them all!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Why don't we make a quick
grocery run? Let's make our very
own
ramen together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And without a moment's delay, we're out
the door, on our way to
explore the
noodley miracles of the local market.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hm hmm hm hmmm ♪ We've got
sprouts, lettuce, mushrooms,
minced meat,
and eggs.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey Fine! Whatcha up to?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Well, my trainer and I are
planning to test the best toppings
for
instant ramen, so we're out buying
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Ramen toppings? I guess you could try
some random meat and
cabbage. That's
what we'd usually toss in back home.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
My dad would always put weird pub
snacks in ours. Like he'd put
dried salami
in, and call it his house special...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you've made original ramen before? You have to tell me more! We could all have a big ramen tasting party!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
If we play our cards right,
Fine'll make it a
high-society sensation or
something. Can
you imagine—royal instant ramen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Fine's friends along for the ride, we
grab a couple more
ingredients and head
back to my office.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Sláinte!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Y'know, this salami isn't half bad.
It's kinda like those pork
flavor packets,
but actual meat.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
The crab sticks I put in work pretty well
too. They add like, I dunno...
an extra
layer of flavor, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...An "extra layer." I bet you sound
like a
food reporter in your head,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! They really do taste completely
different, though. I might try
making it for
my parents some time, when I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Now we're talking!
If any of their friends in
high places want my secret recipe, I
wouldn't mind sharing—as long as they pay
me royalties.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Please. As if you invented grocery store
ramen. Can it, or your
masterpiece is
gonna go cold.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Exactly,
and the noodles go limp if they sit
too long. Ramen is best
right in the
moment!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It... it all is, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Nothing, I just realized something
important, thanks to you
three.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Big special events are all well and good,
but I don't have to make
everything an
occasion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot to be said for simply
enjoying
the time I get to spend
with you here and
now. Every day is a treasure.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well then, before things go cold...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's savor what's in front of us. We can
waffle on about the future
when it gets
here. Right?
